steps.code:
# I have 3 roommates: Jordan, Kathryn, and Nancy. Including me (Troy), that's 4 people total.
# Taxi: $60 / 4 = $15 per person. I paid, so each roommate owes me $15.
# Food: $128 / 4 = $32 per person. Nancy paid, so I owe Nancy $32.
# Let me create payment requests for taxi from each roommate.
venmo_access_token = venmo_login["access_token"]

roommate_emails = ["jo-harr@gmail.com", "kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com", "nan_ritt@gmail.com"]
for email in roommate_emails:
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(user_email=email, amount=15.0, access_token=venmo_access_token, description="For Taxi")
    print(f"Request to {email}:", result)
